name: Fruitwood Farms
description: Fruitwood Farms is a working farm in Monroeville, NJ. It grows Strawberries, Apples, Pears, Peaches, and Cherries, with seasonal availability through spring, autumn, and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
